Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern Café Ceiling Pendant Light Chandelier Fixture, 10.75"W x 58.75" Cord, Matte Black and Chrome
Colors: Matte Black/Chrome
Materials: Metal
This sleek, black matte-finished dome pendant is the ultimate in modern sophistication. A chrome band adds a bold, handsome style touch, while the clear cord can be adjusted to just the right height for a kitchen, living room or entryway. 12"W x 12"D. 10.75"-58.75" cord can be adjusted for height. Clear cord, black matte-finished metal with chrome trim, frosted glass Clean lines, along with black and chrome finishes, provide a contemporary style. Bulbs not included Intended for indoor use only Professional installation suggested
